# bithuman

> First-party command-line tool for the bitHuman avatar platform, distributed
> via the universal installer (https://install.bithuman.ai) and this Homebrew tap. Run a live, talking avatar
> in your browser, render avatars to MP4 files, manage showcase models, and
> drive the whole platform from an AI agent. Built for both humans and AI
> agents: every command supports `--json` with a stable, versioned schema and
> sysexits exit codes, and a built-in MCP server (`bithuman mcp`).

For agents: pass `--json` to any command for one machine-readable object on
stdout; failures emit `{"error":{"code","message","command"}}` on stderr and a
typed exit code (0 ok, 2 usage, 66 not-found, 69 unavailable, 70 internal, 77
auth). stdout is data only. Authenticate headless with `BITHUMAN_API_SECRET`,
or `printf %s "$KEY" | bithuman login --with-token`. Full contract:
https://docs.bithuman.ai/platforms/cli/reference

## Install
- macOS + Linux (x86_64/aarch64), the recommended install: `curl -fsSL https://install.bithuman.ai | sh`
- Windows (x86_64), PowerShell: `irm https://install.bithuman.ai/windows | iex`
- Homebrew (macOS, Apple Silicon), always as ONE line with the tap's URL:
  `brew tap bithuman/bithuman https://gitlab.com/bithuman/sdk/homebrew-bithuman && brew install bithuman-cli`
  (the installed command is `bithuman`). Never shorten it to
  `brew install bithuman/bithuman/bithuman-cli` on a machine that has not tapped the URL:
  without the URL Homebrew looks for the tap on GitHub, where `github.com/bithuman` is not a
  bitHuman account.
- No package manager: the per-target tarball from the newest `cli-v*` release,
  https://downloads.bithuman.ai/homebrew-bithuman/<tag>/<asset> (today `cli-v2.8.8`;
  https://downloads.bithuman.ai/homebrew-bithuman/latest.json names the newest) —
  `bithuman-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.gz`, `bithuman-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz` or
  `bithuman-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz`, each with a `.sha256` beside it.

The CLI is not distributed on PyPI. `pip install bithuman-cli` is not an
install path for it: that name is retired as a user-facing coordinate and does
not resolve today, so do not suggest it. `pip install bithuman` is the Python
SDK library only and deliberately puts no `bithuman` command on PATH — the
binary comes from one of the three lines above.

The conversation brain is included with your account — `bithuman run`
bootstraps a managed brain on first use (billed to credits; just `bithuman
login`). No `pip install` needed for chat.

## Self-describing entrypoints (no docs needed)
- `bithuman __schema`: entire command/flag/exit-code tree + MCP tool catalog as
  JSON, generated from the installed binary — the source of truth, never drifts.
- `bithuman <command> --help`: per-command flags + a copy-pasteable `EXAMPLES:` block.
- `bithuman completion bash|zsh|fish|elvish|powershell`: shell completions.

## Common commands
- `bithuman run <slug-or-path>`: live, talking avatar in the browser. `--json` emits a `session_started` event with the URL.
- `bithuman doctor --json`: install health; exit 0 iff `.ready` is true.
- `bithuman list --json`: showcase manifest; `.models[].slug` are downloadable.
- `bithuman pull <slug>`: download a model; prints the cached `.imx` path.
- `bithuman info <model.imx> --json`: model metadata.
- `bithuman render <model.imx> in.wav -o out.mp4`: render an MP4 file.
- `bithuman account --json`: identity, plan, credits.
- `bithuman mcp`: built-in MCP server over stdio (JSON-RPC) for MCP clients —
  cloud tools (TTS, agents, dynamics, embed, webhooks, credits) + local tools.

## SDKs (not in this repository)
This repository is the CLI's tap and installers only. The SDKs have their own projects; take
versions from https://docs.bithuman.ai/versions.json:
- Swift (iPhone, iPad, Mac): `.package(url: "https://gitlab.com/bithuman/sdk/bithuman-swift", from: "3.0.0")`.
  Apps on 2.x keep `https://github.com/bithuman-product/homebrew-bithuman.git` (every 2.x tag
  stays there); 2.x critical fixes are tagged only in sdk/bithuman-swift, the URL to switch to for one.
  Never point SwiftPM at the GitLab homebrew-bithuman repository.
  Docs: https://docs.bithuman.ai/platforms/ios
- Flutter: `bithuman: ^3.0.0` from pub.dev (source https://gitlab.com/bithuman/sdk/bithuman-flutter).
  Docs: https://docs.bithuman.ai/platforms/flutter
- Android: `ai.bithuman:bithuman-android` from https://maven.bithuman.ai.
  Docs: https://docs.bithuman.ai/platforms/android
Sessions need an API secret (Creator plan or higher from 12 October 2026).
